title: going to: plans & intentions
grammarTitle: Going to — планы, намерения и очевидные предсказания
grammarNote:
"Going to" — это одна из самых важных конструкций для выражения будущего в английском языке. Мы используем её в трёх основных случаях.

📌 СЛУЧАЙ 1: ПЛАНЫ И НАМЕРЕНИЯ (самый частый случай)
Когда человек уже РЕШИЛ что-то сделать — до момента разговора.

"I am going to do an internship this summer." (Я решила — это мой план)
"She is going to move back to Taraz after graduation." (Это её намерение — уже решено)
"We are going to travel to Turkestan in August." (Запланировано заранее)

В казахском: "Мен стажировкаға барамын" (барамын = going to go)
В русском: "Я собираюсь пройти стажировку"

📌 СЛУЧАЙ 2: ПРЕДСКАЗАНИЯ НА ОСНОВЕ ДОКАЗАТЕЛЬСТВ
Когда вы ВИДИТЕ что-то и делаете вывод о ближайшем будущем.

"Look at those clouds! It's going to rain!" (видишь тучи → вывод)
"She's going to fall — the path is very icy!" (видишь скользкий путь → очевидно)
"He hasn't studied at all — he's going to fail the exam." (очевидно из ситуации)

📐 ФОРМУЛА: am/is/are + going to + БАЗОВЫЙ ГЛАГОЛ

✅ УТВЕРЖДЕНИЕ:
I am going to study. (полная форма)
I'm going to study. (сокращённая — более естественная в речи)
She is going to leave. = She's going to leave.
They are going to visit. = They're going to visit.

✅ ОТРИЦАНИЕ:
I am NOT going to leave.
I'm not going to leave. ← самая естественная форма
He is not going to stay. = He isn't going to stay.
We are not going to leave. = We aren't going to leave.

✅ ВОПРОСЫ:
Are you going to come? → Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Is she going to stay? → Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
What are you going to do? → I'm going to study.
Where is he going to work? → He's going to work in Taraz.

⚠️ ТИПИЧНЫЕ ОШИБКИ:
❌ "I going to study." — нет глагола be!
❌ "I am go to study." — нужно "going", не "go"!
❌ "I am going study." — нужно "to" между going и глаголом!
✅ "I am going TO study." — всё на месте!

⏰ СЛОВА-СИГНАЛЫ для "going to" (времени):
this summer · tonight · tomorrow · next week / month / year
after I graduate · soon · in the future · in two years
in the morning / afternoon / evening · this time next year

💡 "GOING TO" vs PRESENT SIMPLE для расписания:
Мы используем Present Simple для официального расписания транспорта:
"The train LEAVES at 7 pm." (расписание поезда — фиксировано)
Но для ЛИЧНОГО плана — "going to":
"I'm going to TAKE the 7 pm train." (мой план)

Оба могут быть правильными в разном контексте!

grammarExtra.title: ① Утвердительные предложения с going to

rows.example: "I'M going to apply for a scholarship." · "I'M going to study much more systematically next semester." — Aibek.
"She'S going to spend three weeks in Aktau." · "He'S going to book the train tickets tonight." — Marat.
"We'RE going to visit Panfilov Park on Saturday." · "They'RE going to take the cable car to Shymbulak."
Полная: "I am going to study." → Сокращённая: "I'm going to study." — в разговоре сокращённая звучит более естественно.
❌ "I going to study." (нет am!) → ✅ "I'M going to study." · ❌ "She going to leave." → ✅ "She'S going to leave."
"I'm going to do an internship." · "We're going to travel to Turkestan." · "She's going to teach me her beshbarmak recipe."

grammarExtra.title: ② Отрицательные предложения: NOT going to

rows.example: "I'M NOT going to leave Kazakhstan permanently." · "I'm not going to buy a new phone." — Aliya's decisions.
"She ISN'T going to go home straight away." · "He's not going to work in Almaty." — their plans.
"They AREN'T going to wait any longer." · "We're not going to stay at a hotel — we chose a hostel." — Marat.
am not going to → I'm NOT (нельзя сократить "amn't"!) · is not → isn't · are not → aren't ✅
✅ "I'm not going to study." — правильно. ❌ "I amn't going to study." — так не говорят в современном английском!
"I'm NOT going to go home straight away." · "We're NOT going to stay at a hotel." · "He's not going to work in Almaty."

grammarExtra.title: ③ Вопросы с going to и краткие ответы

rows.example: "Are you going to come?" — "Yes, I am." / "No, I'm not." ✅ · "Is she going to stay?" — "Yes, she is." / "No, she isn't."
"WHAT are you going to do?" · "WHERE is she going to work?" · "WHEN are we going to leave?" · "WHO is going to book the tickets?"
Вопрос: Am/Is/Are + Подлежащее + going to + глагол? → "ARE you going to study?" ✅ · ❌ "You are going to study?" — это не вопрос, это утверждение с вопросительной интонацией.
"Are you going to go to Almaty?" → "Yes, I AM." / "No, I'M NOT." — повторяем вспомогательный глагол из вопроса.

rows.form: Вопрос "What... going to do?" — очень частый:
rows.example: "What are YOU going to do after graduation?" · "What IS she going to study?" · "What ARE they going to eat?"
"Are we still GOING TO go to Almaty?" · "What are you GOING TO do?" · "Are you GOING TO be free on Thursday evenings?"

grammarExtra.title: ④ Предсказания на основе доказательств + слова-сигналы

rows.example: "Look at those dark clouds! It's GOING TO rain!" (видишь тучи) · "She's going to fall — the path is icy!" (видишь опасность)

rows.form: Сравни: going to (доказательство) vs will (общее предсказание):
rows.example: "It's going to rain!" (вижу тучи — уверен) vs "I think it will rain tomorrow." (предполагаю — не уверен)
tonight · tomorrow · next week / month / year · this summer · after I graduate · soon · in the future · in two years · this time next year
"I'm going to study TONIGHT." · "She's going to leave TOMORROW MORNING." · "We're going to visit NEXT WEEKEND."
"We're going to leave on Friday THE 4TH OF OCTOBER." · "The internship starts on THE 15TH OF JUNE."
"I'm going to spend time with my family THIS SUMMER." · "AFTER I GRADUATE, I'm going to apply for a Master's degree."

grammarTip:
Три шага — и "going to" всегда правильное:

① Проверь формулу: am/is/are + going to + базовый глагол:
   I AM going TO study. ✅
   She IS going TO leave. ✅
   They ARE going TO travel. ✅

② Запомни три ловушки:
   ❌ "I going to study." — забыл am!
   ❌ "I am go to study." — нужно going, не go!
   ❌ "I am going study." — нужно "to" перед глаголом!
   ✅ "I am going TO study." — все три части на месте!

③ Думай о ситуации:
   Уже решил/запланировал → going to (план)
   Видишь доказательство → going to (предсказание)
   Спонтанное решение → will (следующий урок!)

💡 Запомни через урок:
   "I'm going to do an internship." (Aliya — план)
   "We're going to travel to Turkestan." (Kairat — план)
   "It's going to be cold at Shymbulak!" (Marat — предсказание)

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form of "going to".
exercises.text: Aliya ___ do a one-year internship after she graduates.
exercises.hint: She = 3rd person singular → IS going to. Full form: "Aliya IS going TO do an internship." ✅ Remember: be verb (am/is/are) + going to + base verb.

exercises.text: Aliya ___ (not / leave) Kazakhstan permanently. She wants to work there.
exercises.hint: "Aliya IS NOT going to leave" = "She ISN'T going to leave." ✅ Negative: is/am/are + NOT + going to + base verb. "isn't going to leave" — all three parts correct!

exercises.text: "Are you going to come to the trip?" — "Yes, I going to." is a correct short answer.
exercises.hint: Short answers use the auxiliary verb (am/is/are), not "going to"! ✅ "Yes, I AM." (not "Yes, I going to.") · "No, I'M NOT." — always repeat the be verb from the question.

exercises.text: You want to ask Kairat about his summer plans. Which question is correct?
opts: What you are going to do this summer?
What are you going to do this summer?
What you going to do this summer?
What are you go to do this summer?
exercises.correct: What are you going to do this summer?
exercises.hint: Wh- question order: What + ARE + you + going to + do? ✅ The auxiliary verb (are) comes before the subject (you) in questions. "going to" not "go to"!

exercises.instruction: Complete the sentence with going to.
exercises.text: "Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain very soon!"
exercises.hint: Evidence-based prediction (you can SEE the dark clouds) → IS going to. "It IS going TO rain!" ✅ This is the evidence prediction use of "going to".

exercises.text: Marat has bought the train tickets and planned everything. Which sentence is correct?
opts: They going to leave on Friday.
They are go to leave on Friday.
They are going leave on Friday.
They are going to leave on Friday.
exercises.correct: They are going to leave on Friday.
exercises.hint: "They ARE going TO leave" ✅ — are (✅) + going (✅) + to (✅) + leave (base verb ✅). Every element is correct. The other options miss one element each.

exercises.text: "I'm not going to come" and "I am not going to come" have the same meaning.
exercises.hint: TRUE! "I'm not going to come" (contracted) = "I am not going to come" (full form). Same meaning, different style. Contracted form is more natural in speech; full form is more formal.

exercises.instruction: Choose the time expression that fits "going to".
exercises.text: Gulim ___ visit an architecture firm in Almaty ___.
exercises.hint: "Going to" describes FUTURE plans → use future time expressions! "this summer" = future ✅. "yesterday" and "last week" are past — cannot use with "going to" for plans. She IS (singular) going to visit.
